tasks.short: Plan and evaluate new materials projects.

steps.what: Plan new materials projects by identifying performance requirements, test needs and feasible process routes
Assemble explicit project quantities, timing and cost comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}
Consult engineers and corporate executives about feasibility, priorities and trade-offs
Evaluate the project and complete the plan and recommendation in {PROJECT}, checking calculations and actual consultation findings
outputs: checked final project evaluation and plan

steps.what: Save the checked project evaluation and plan in {PROJECT}
inputs: checked final project evaluation and plan

tasks.design: Configure explicit cost and timing formulas in {SPREADSHEET} for materials-project comparisons. The engineer still chooses feasible routes, consults colleagues and executives and writes the evaluation and plan in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison arithmetic can delay evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can calculate explicit alternatives without judging feasibility.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a viable materials route under uncertain scale-up performance.
tasks.human_edge: Process knowledge and weighing stakeholder priorities.

ambition.what: No extra project or investment authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less comparison arithmetic, unchanged project judgement.

evidence.claim: Explicit spreadsheet calculations can support project alternatives while technical feasibility and consultation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes plan writing, consultation and evaluation, not a separately named proposal, budget or management report in 9007. No cost transfer or saving is counted twice.
Finance supplies authorized rate, unit and effective date; the engineer supplies route, quantity, duration and assumptions in s1-s2. Missing rates are checked manually in retained s2 effort.

Native formulas first. Only repeated calculation changes; technical reading, conversations and actual plan writing remain. The normal final check in s4 binds the completed saved version. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Actual repeated arithmetic and current formula coverage.
research_questions: Do formulas reduce comparison time without hiding uncertain scale-up assumptions?

already_counted.description: Consultation and final project evaluation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain rate lookups and comparison formulas.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final project plan and evaluation checked in s4; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 45% less time in the 20-share comparison step gives 9 gross points less 1 upkeep. Low is formulas already present or no repeated calculation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual assignments and technical work products before supervising technologists, technicians, engineers and scientists
outputs: understood work status and technical issues

steps.what: Supervise the work through observation, technical discussion, coaching and decisions about unresolved issues
inputs: understood work status and technical issues

steps.what: Write actual follow-up instructions on the existing work item in {PROJECT}, checking the technical meaning
Post the checked instruction to the assigned internal work item in {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Keep actual technical review and supervision human. The existing {PROJECT} work item already provides identity and a place for follow-up instructions, so a new template or model adds no established saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical guidance is specific to the observed work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work-item records already support the small written follow-up.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing weaknesses in unfamiliar technical work and coaching the person.

ambition.what: No expanded supervisory span is promised.

evidence.claim: Existing project work items can hold instructions, but technical supervision depends on understanding actual work.

assumptions: Boundary includes review, direct supervision and the actual written follow-up, split out before declaring zero. It does not include generating a second management report or recording other people's experiment results.

Team members supply actual work products and status; the engineer reads them in s1 and produces actual instructions in s3. Missing status requires conversation within s2, not automated completion inference.

Native work items already supply identity and headings. The remaining instruction is technical meaning, so no template reduction is assumed. No tool change means zero upkeep. Normal author checking in s3 binds the posted content and assigned recipient.
unknowns: Frequency of actual written follow-up versus purely verbal guidance.
research_questions: Is any repeated administrative entry present beyond existing work-item fields?

already_counted.description: Review, direct supervision and instruction writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact instruction and assigned work item checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual reading, guidance, writing and posting are explicit and unchanged; no new repeated administration is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise industrial materials production and testing.

steps.what: Read actual production and test trends in the plant operations system {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining interpretation of process limits and anomalies
Supervise production and testing processes in refining, smelting, foundry or nonmetallic production through actual observation and operator discussion
Determine corrective direction and explain it to operators under the existing plant authority procedure
Write and check actual supervisory observations and agreed corrective direction in the plant log {OPS_SYSTEM}
Save the checked supervisory log entry in {OPS_SYSTEM}

tasks.design: Configure a native batch-linked trend view in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reduce navigation among actual production and test readings. Interpretation, plant presence, corrective direction and the actual supervisory log remain human; there is no automatic process-control command.
tasks.previous_blocker: Batch and test readings may require separate screen navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native batch links and trend views can place existing readings together.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing real process instability and choosing safe direction.
tasks.human_edge: Plant awareness and practical materials-process judgement.

ambition.what: No autonomous plant supervision is promised.

reach.task: Make batch evidence easier to inspect

evidence.claim: Native industrial trend views can combine existing batch evidence; supervisory judgement and process direction remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual supervision and the supervisory log. Operators' execution and physical process time are not focal effort or claimed savings. Internal direction is conversation, not external action.

Existing instrumentation and operator records supply batch ID, timestamp, value, unit, test method and status; actual operator capture is unchanged and no new feed is assumed. Missing readings are checked manually within retained s1-s2 work.

Native views first. Only navigation within s1 changes, not interpreting trends. Existing log headers are already supplied, so substantive log writing and save retain full effort. The normal check in s4 binds the saved entry.
unknowns: Whether batch and test views are already linked.
research_questions: Can linked native views reduce navigation without mixing batches or methods?

already_counted.description: Actual supervision and corrective judgement remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain batch links and trend view settings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact supervisory entry checked in s4; changes require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20% less navigation within the 20-share reading step gives 4 points less 0.75 upkeep. Low is an already linked native view.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare proposals, budgets, labor-cost analysis and reports.

steps.what: Establish actual managerial requirements, resource assumptions and the intended proposal or report audience
Prepare proposals in {DOCS}, writing the material-process rationale and reusing native controlled structure
Save the checked proposal in {DOCS}
Prepare and check budgets from explicit quantities, approved rates and actual costs in {SPREADSHEET}
Save the checked budget in {PROJECT}
Analyze labor costs by reconciling actual hours and cost rates and interpreting variance against the work performed
Write and check managerial reports explaining actual results, labor-cost variance, limits and recommendations
Save the checked managerial report in {DOCS}
Send the checked managerial report to its internal management recipients through {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure native proposal and report fields in {DOCS} and explicit cost and variance formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, using approved exports from {ERP}. The engineer retains scope, quantities, interpretation and prose conclusions; each completed artefact is checked before its separate save, and the report before its internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Managerial outputs repeat structure and explicit cost arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fields and formulas can reuse approved facts without generating managerial conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining variance and choosing realistic resource assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing whether costs reflect actual process work and what action is appropriate.

ambition.what: No additional spending or personnel authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated assembly, unchanged managerial accountability.

evidence.claim: Native document fields and explicit cost formulas can reduce managerial output assembly while interpretation and final checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is the task's own proposals, budgets, labor-cost analysis and reports. Project feasibility planning in 9009 is an input when already performed; its calculation and consultation work are not repeated here.

Finance supplies cost code, actual hours, approved rate, currency and effective date from existing approved records; supervisors supply actual work context. The engineer supplies quantities and narrative in s2, s4, s6 and s7. Missing or disputed data is reconciled manually in retained work; no estimated schedule becomes actual labor.

Native settings first. Reductions concern repeated structure, arithmetic and approved table reuse, not technical or personnel judgement. No model rates individual workers. Access and any employee consultation follow national rules.

Normal author checks occur after each output exists in s2, s4 and s7. s7 checks the exact report and internal recipients. Changes void the corresponding gate; ordinary saves and send retain full effort.
unknowns: Actual formula coverage and repeated report-table entry.
research_questions: Can approved cost exports reduce reconciliation without confusing planned and actual labor?

already_counted.description: Requirements and retained labor-cost interpretation and reconciliation.

incremental.description: Maintain cost formulas, report fields and access mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal checked in s2; edits require recheck.
Exact budget checked in s4; edits require recheck.
Exact report checked in s7; edits require recheck.
Exact report and management recipients checked in s7; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 3.75 proposal, 7 budget, 4.5 labor-analysis and 3.9 report points total 19.15 less 2 upkeep. Low is native reuse already present or incomplete approved records.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit resource and process evidence while keeping materials judgement and supervision human.
reach: Help cost controllers understand process-driven labor variance.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who can connect actual materials-process evidence to clear managerial decisions.
